faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What interior design services are available in Pitampura?

Space planning, concept design, 3D views, working drawings, material and furniture selection, lighting design and site supervision for homes and commercial spaces.

Can I visit your office to see materials?

Yes. Our head office is at Netaji Subhash Place, Pitampura, and we review samples and drawings with clients there.

Do you offer design-only packages?

Yes. You can choose design and drawings only, or design with supervision. We explain the scope of each before you decide.

Why choose local interior design services?

A nearby team can visit the site often, respond quickly and solve problems on the spot, which keeps the project moving.
